type_descriptions.ANL: You love solving problems, working with data, and thinking deeply before acting. You ask why and how more than most people.
type_descriptions.LDR: You are a natural at guiding people, making decisions under pressure, and taking responsibility when it counts.
type_descriptions.CRE: You think outside the box, express yourself boldly, and see possibilities where others see walls.
type_descriptions.HLP: You are driven by purpose. You care deeply about people and feel most alive when you are making a real difference in someone's life.
type_descriptions.TEC: You enjoy building, fixing and understanding exactly how systems and processes work. You want to make things that function.
type_descriptions.ENT: You are ambitious, spot opportunities others miss, and feel the pull to build something of your own from nothing.

questions.question: When you imagine your ideal future working day, what are you doing?

options.text: Researching, analysing information and solving complex problems
Building, engineering or designing systems that actually work
Running my own venture and making high-stakes decisions
Leading a team and driving a project toward a meaningful goal

questions.question: Which of these best describes how your mind naturally works?

options.text: Logically — I reason through problems step by step using evidence
Creatively — I imagine new approaches and see things differently
Strategically — I think about goals, plans and how to move people forward
Empathetically — I tune into how others feel and what they need

questions.question: Which type of activity gives you the most energy?

options.text: Hands-on technical work — figuring out how things work and making them better
Spotting a gap in the market and figuring out how to fill it profitably
Making or expressing something original — visual, written or performed
Supporting, guiding or caring for someone through a difficult situation

questions.question: When your group faces a really hard challenge, what do you naturally do?

options.text: Dig into the available information until you fully understand the problem
Suggest a creative or unexpected angle that others have not considered
Take charge, assign roles and steer the group toward a clear solution
Make sure everyone is heard and keep focus on the human impact

questions.question: Which of these environments would you thrive in the most?

options.text: A quiet research or data-focused workspace with room to think deeply
A technical lab, engineering floor or digital development environment
A fast-moving business environment where every day brings new decisions
A creative studio, media space or design-driven workplace

questions.question: What kind of impact do you most want your career to have?

options.text: Creating or improving systems and processes that make things work better
Generating economic value, creating jobs and building lasting wealth
Leading an institution or movement that influences many people
Directly improving the health, safety or wellbeing of individuals

questions.question: How would your closest friends most honestly describe you?

options.text: Deeply curious — always asking questions and needing to understand things fully
Ambitious and driven — always pushing for the next level
Warm and dependable — the one people turn to when they need genuine support
Bold and expressive — always doing or saying something original

questions.question: Which of these achievements would make you the most proud?

options.text: Building a system or tool that thousands of people depend on every day
Producing a creative work that genuinely moves or inspires people
Being a respected leader who shaped the direction of an organisation
Spending a career healing, teaching or transforming lives at a personal level
